assessment_summary.project_name: LX-3 battery cold plate CHT model
assessment_summary.cou_name: Pre-PDR thermal margin verification, radiator sizing, and pump setpoint selection for lunar rover avionics bay cold plate under steady/quasi-steady conditions within defined envelope

evidence_keywords: Singularity container with pinned OS and library stack
Git repository with tag v1.7.3
Regression checks: Three benchmark cases
last 12 weeks show invariant results
Vendor patches 2023.2.2 evaluated against benchmarks
Manufactured conduction: On a 3D block
observed order 2.01
laminar case matched analytical Nusselt = 4.36 to within 0.9%
Radiative exchange: Parallel plate test case matched analytical solution within 0.5%
Three systematically refined meshes (7.4M, 12.9M, 22.6M cells)
Grid convergence index (three-grid method, safety factor 1.25)
estimated discretization uncertainty of 0.8 C
Observed spatial order for temperature ≈1.9
Residual targets of 1e-5 for continuity and momentum and 1e-8 for energy
outlet mass flow variation <0.02%
monitor points stable to <0.01 C
No limit cycles were observed
scripts and containers enforce repeatability
Model Description Document (MDD-LX3-CHT-002, Rev. C)
Independent review by Dr. A. Johansson
both completed vendor training on conjugate heat transfer
k-ω SST chosen based on channel Reynolds numbers 900–4500
transitional effects examined at 900–1100
Radiation: Viewfactor-based approximation tested versus DOM
No boiling, no cavitation
Material data: 6061-T6 with temperature-dependent conductivity
coolant property tables (density, viscosity, Cp, k) from CoolProp v6.4
contact conductance fitted from 24 clamp/load tests
channel roughness measured on 5 coupons
a replica cold plate machined to the same drawing tolerances
20 battery cell simulators bolted to the plate
measured thermal contact resistances
Test matrix: 18 points spanning three flow rates (3, 6, 9 L/min)
two inlet temps (5, 25 C)
three total heat loads (1.2, 4.5, 7.8 kW)
Each point run to thermal steady state (<0.05 C/min drift)
Model-to-data comparison used the as-tested geometry
including measured channel roughness Ra = 2.8 μm
and inlet conditions
we also swapped to 50% mixture and altered clamping torque
predicted peak plate temperature deviated from thermocouple readings by mean absolute 1.9 C (RMS 2.4 C)
95% of points within ±4.8 C
Comparison of pressure drops matched within 7% RMS
Heat balance closure remained within 3%
